dossier_meta.paper: Induced subgraphs of graphs with large chromatic number. IV. Consecutiv…
dossier_meta.statement_text: Is there an infinite set $F$ of positive integers such that $F$ is constricting and has density $0$?
dossier_meta.context_text: The authors discuss which infinite sets are constricting, noting that not every infinite set is constricting (not even sets with upper density one), while sets with bounded gaps are 3-constricting. Lower density seems closer to the truth, and the authors conjecture the answer to Problem 1.6 is positive.
